Bank of Baroda Specialist Officer SO Admit Card 2026 – Full Details

Bank of Baroda (BOB) has released the Admit Card for the post of Specialist Officer SO. This recruitment was released for 206 posts. Applications for the Bank of Baroda Specialist Officer SO Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 06 August 2026, to 26 August 2026. The online examination is going to be conducted on 01 November 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their Bank of Baroda Specialist Officer SO Admit Card 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Online Apply Start Date : 06 August 2026
  • Online Apply Last Date : 26 August 2026
  • Last Date For Fee Payment : 26 August 2026
  • Exam Date : 01 November 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam
  • Result Date : Will Be Updated Here Soon

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : ₹ 850/-
  • SC, ST, PWD, ESM/DESM & Women : ₹ 175/-

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Click on the official Admit Card link given below.
  2. Login using your Application Number / Roll Number and Password / DOB.
  3. Your Admit Card will be displayed on screen.
  4. Download the PDF and take a clear printout to carry to the exam venue.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is Bank of Baroda Specialist Officer SO Admit Card 2026?

Bank of Baroda Specialist Officer SO Admit Card 2026 is the official hall ticket for the upcoming examination. Candidates must carry it along with a valid photo ID to the exam centre.

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
